هِنْدِىٌّ : see هِنْدٌ. ―
-b2- Also, Indian aloes-wood. (L.) ―
-b3- سَيْفٌ هِنْدِىٌّ, (L,) and ↓ هِنْدُوَانِىٌّ , [in the CK هِنْدَوَانِىٌّ,] and هُنْدُوَانِىٌّ, (S, A, L, K,) A sword made in the country of الهِنْد, [or India,] and well fabricated: (L:) or, made of the iron of that country: (A:) as also ↓ مُهَنَّدٌ , in the latter sense, (S, A, L,) and in the former: (L:) so termed in relation to the people called الهِنْد: (K:) and ↓ سَيْفٌ مُهَنَّدٌ a sharpened, or sharp, sword. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
